example.title: Broad Street, French Quarter, Charleston, SC (49451727813) (building 1 of the row)

brief: A three-storey Georgian commercial block on Broad Street, the left of three in the row: cream stucco, a pedimented gable with a lunette, tall 6/6 sash windows in plain surrounds, a shopfront at street level behind palmettos. One photo. Older than 1970: the Charleston / New England main-street block is an 18th-19th-century type (the town's model). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
